_comment: Per-world graph patches applied after build_data.py. Each entry connects two nodes the upstream skiroute builder split into separate places. Run via scripts/apply_patches.py. See scripts/audit_duplicates.py for finding candidates.

add_edges._note: Dissolves the Bois de Saule / Funiculaire 1 pocket. The pocket contains a stranded 'Funiculaire 1 bottom' at 1128m that's really the same station as the main 'Funiculaire 1 bottom' at 808m. We model the bridge as the funicular ride itself: pocket → main funi top.
add_edges.name: Funiculaire Les Arcs' Express (bridge)

add_edges._note: Reverse: ride the funicular down from the main top into the pocket. Higher cost (matches lift_down convention).
add_edges.name: Funiculaire Les Arcs' Express (bridge, down)
